libdir.description: Directory where rlm_* modules are located

max_request_time.description: Maximum time in seconds to handle a request

cleanup_delay.description: Time in seconds to wait before cleaning up a reply

max_requests.description: Maximum number of requests the server keeps track of

hostname_lookups.description: Log names of clients or just their IP addresses

log_destination.description: Destination for log messages (files, syslog, stdout, stderr)

log_colourise.description: Highlight important messages sent to stderr and stdout

log_syslog_facility.description: Syslog facility to use if destination is syslog

log_stripped_names.description: Log the full User-Name attribute as found in the request

log_auth.description: Log all authentication results to the log file

security_max_attributes.description: Maximum number of attributes permitted in a RADIUS packet

security_reject_delay.description: Delay in seconds when sending an Access-Reject

security_status_server.description: Whether the server responds to Status-Server requests

security_limit_proxy_state.description: Limit the combination of Proxy-State and Message-Authenticator

proxy_requests.description: Turns proxying of RADIUS requests on or off

thread_pool_start_servers.description: Number of servers to start initially

thread_pool_max_servers.description: Limit on the total number of servers running

thread_pool_max_requests_per_server.description: Clean up old threads periodically (0 means infinity)

thread_pool_auto_limit_acct.description: Automatically limit the number of accounting requests
